## Checklist

- [ ] One line added to `data.js` in the right category, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The link is the official HTTPS URL, loads, and is not a referral link
- [ ] The description is one short, neutral sentence taken from the project's own site or repo
- [ ] Logo left `""` unless it is the project's own logo with a clear licence, saved as a 64×64 PNG in `assets/logos/`
- [ ] I understand a listing is not an endorsement
